findings.issue: staged Asset Viewer rebuild indexed the previous canonical Asset Viewer
findings.cause: asset_viewer.siig-update-part was excluded from source walking but root/asset_viewer was not
findings.fix: canonical asset_viewer is excluded whenever the output is a different staged directory

findings.issue: Visualizer/Stage Explorer-only migrations forced Asset Viewer rebuilds
findings.cause: refresh_viewer treated sibling generated tools as upstream viewer dependencies
findings.fix: viewer refresh now follows only indexed asset/localization/font/audio/structured source changes or the viewer generator itself

findings.issue: WIP197 final verification failure made recovery fall back to exhaustive hashing
findings.fix: verification_failed + recovery journal + refreshed output manifest is recognized as a final-gate recovery baseline and stays scoped

findings.issue: host-created metadata could appear as one untracked file
findings.fix: Thumbs.db, desktop.ini and .DS_Store are excluded from output integrity accounting

findings.issue: runtime errors printed the full argparse usage banner
findings.fix: runtime exceptions now print concise ERROR lines; final update verification lists concrete issue kind/path
